MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING

This Memorandum of Understanding (this "Memorandum") is made as of April 13, 2026 between Harbor Arts Collective, a nonprofit corporation (the "Collective"), and Riverside Public Library, a municipal library (the "Library").

1. Purpose. The purpose of this Memorandum is to record how the parties will work together to offer a free summer reading and arts program for children aged six to eleven (the "Program") at the Library's main branch.

2. The Library's Responsibilities. The Library will provide its community room on Saturday mornings from 9:00 am to noon, promote the Program in its newsletter and on its website, register the children, and have one staff member present at each session.

3. The Collective's Responsibilities. The Collective will provide two teaching artists for each session, plan the art activities to go with the books the Library chooses, bring the art supplies, and carry liability insurance covering its teaching artists.

4. Costs. Each party bears its own costs of taking part in the Program. No money changes hands between the parties, and neither party may commit the other to any expense.

5. Children's Safety. Each party will make sure that every adult it sends to a session has passed a background check within the past two years. Neither party will photograph a child without a parent's written permission.

6. Term. This Memorandum runs from June 1, 2026 to August 31, 2026. Either party may end it earlier on 14 days' written notice to the other.

7. Contacts. The Library's contact is its Youth Services Librarian. The Collective's contact is its Education Director.

8. Not Legally Binding. This Memorandum is a statement of the parties' intentions and is not legally binding, except for Section 5, which each party agrees to follow for as long as the Program runs.

HARBOR ARTS COLLECTIVE

By: ______________________
Name: Lucia Brandt
Title: Executive Director

RIVERSIDE PUBLIC LIBRARY
